rule.label: Rule pick
rule.exit: +5% limit sell at once; sell at the open after the 5th close if not filled. Safety line −8% (not part of the tested rule).

near.label: Near-rule (weaker)
near.exit: Same as the rule pick: +5% target, out after 5 closes. Weaker setup - smaller size.

breakout.label: Breakout watch (paper)
breakout.exit: Only while the market is up. Hold up to 60 sessions; sell at the next open once the equal-weight Nifty 500 closes below its 100-day average. Paper forward test - the backtest edge may be survivorship. Safety line −10% is for reference, not part of the tested rule.

down.label: Downside watch
down.exit: Expect a −5% pullback within 5 sessions; wrong if it rises 8% instead. Cash: do not buy / book profit if holding. F&O names: a put or short future is the only way to act on it. Weak evidence.

rule: Scanned every trading day after the close. Rule pick = the tested mean-reversion setup (Nifty 500, ≥ ₹1 cr/day): close above the 200-day average and down more than 10% over three closes; near-rule = the same with a 7-10% drop (weaker); breakout = new 52-week high on 1.5x volume above the 200-day average; downside watch = a 10%+ three-day bounce in a stock below its 200-day average, expected to give back 5% (weak evidence: 42% hit in training vs 26% for random days, and it faded on the unseen period). Paper only.
expected: Strength is how closely the stock matches the tested setup (drop, trend margin, liquidity, RSI, volume), weighted by that setup's measured win rate - a match score, not a prediction. Rule picks: 64% hit +5% in the 2021-26 backtest, +1.4% a trade after costs; plan on 8-12% a year on the capital used. Near-rule and breakout tiers are weaker and shown so there is always something to watch.
